interface.title: Self-Audit / 生物医药研究诚信自查 (Biomedical Research Integrity Auditor, local web app)
interface.field: Biomedical research integrity / manuscript quality control (wet-lab, animal and cell studies)
interface.stage_of_work: Pre-submission self-check, plus later re-audit; also triage of public material and preparing a response to a raised concern
interface.what_it_is_for: Point it at a manuscript package folder and it runs a local audit pipeline. The result is a bilingual (English/Chinese) report with an R0–R4 risk level, audit coverage, missing materials, claim-to-evidence coverage, figure-to-raw traceability, and an action tracker the team can edit. It never gives a pass/fail or misconduct verdict.

data.note: I typed the bundled packages 'examples/full_presubmission_package' (13 files, overall R1, 2 verified figure-to-raw links, 2 claims, 4 actions) and 'examples/minimal_package' (1 source-data table, R1, 14 missing-material actions) into the Package path field. No test files were available for the zip upload. Neither example produced any candidate finding (0 statistical, image or text flags), so the risk register and image hand-off list stayed empty. I made six audit runs in total.

features.name: Remediation action tracker with status groups and live correction plan
features.general: Give each to-do item an owner, a status (open / done / accepted with justification / not actionable), a note and an evidence attachment. Saving regroups the list, updates the open count and feeds a derived plan and export.
features.specific: Action Tracker table: edit Owner, Status, Note, Accepted reason and Attachment, then Save. Rows regroup into Unresolved / Resolved / Accepted With Reason. The Correction Plan's Attachment/Status columns, the unresolved_actions.csv export and the Re-audit Diff baseline all update.
steps: pick a Status for a row
type Note and, for acceptance, Accepted reason
press Save and watch the row move group and the count drop
download the CSV or Correction Plan Markdown
serves_tasks: Assign a status, note and justification to each open action
Export the fix list for the team
Compare a new audit against an earlier one to see what was fixed

features.name: Run-to-run diff (re-audit comparison)
features.general: Pick an earlier run as a baseline, rerun, and get before→after counts plus lists of fixed, new and persisting items
features.specific: Sidebar 'Compare to' dropdown of past runs, then Run Audit. The Re-audit Diff card shows Overall R, findings, missing materials, traceability, actions and claim gaps as 'old → new', with Fixed / New / Persisted findings and Resolved / New / Still-missing materials lists.
steps: choose the baseline in Compare to
